section_280e_quotes: The IRS has taken the position that cannabis companies are subject to the limits of Section 280E of the Code for U.S. federal income tax purposes, under which, they are only allowed to deduct expenses directly related to costs of goods sold.
The Company has taken a position that its deduction of ordinary and necessary business expenses is not limited by Section 280E of the Code.

During the year ended December 31, 2024, the Company recorded an uncertain tax liability in uncertain tax positions on the Consolidated Balance Sheet for tax positions taken based on legal interpretations that challenge the Company's tax liability under Section 280E of the Code (“280E Position”).
extraction_notes: Unit scale: the excerpted table headers do not state the scale; unit_multiplier=1000 (thousands) is inferred from internal consistency (net loss $257,908 / 360.9M weighted shares = $0.71 per share as printed) and should be verified against the filing header. Net income: no separate consolidated net loss line exists; the only bottom line is 'Net Loss Attributable to Verano Holdings Corp. & Subsidiaries' (-257,908), used as net_income; the pre-tax line is captioned 'before Provision for Income Taxes and Non-Controlling Interest'. Income tax expense is printed on the statement as (91,678) (deducted from pre-tax loss) but is an expense per the footnote total ($91,678), so reported as +91,678. FY2025 reconciliation adopted ASU 2023-09 prospectively; 2024/2023 comparatives are in the old format (2023 showed an explicit 'Nondeductible 280E' line of 79,731; 2024 and 2025 instead show the 280E cost via the uncertain tax position line). 'Nontaxable or Nondeductible Items' is a header with no amount; its sub-lines are reported individually. The UTP line (113,291; -68.1%) includes penalties and interest (rollforward shows $37,214 interest and penalties on UTPs in 2025) and is the principal 280E cost, but no line is labelled 280E; hence no section_280e line. Percentages are reported as printed: because pre-tax result is a loss, items increasing expense show negative rates; effective rate is (55.2)%. Footnote (1) on the statutory line states Florida state taxes make up the majority of 'this category' (placement appears to relate to state taxes). Line amounts sum exactly to the $91,678 total. Gross unrecognized tax benefits were $473,664 and uncertain tax liabilities $378,261 at 12/31/2025; company is under IRS audit for 2021-2022.
